text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thanks Mrs Albright - now come pay us a visit. U.S. Secretary of State Albright swaps U.S. ban on travel to Lebanon for strongly worded travel advisory.
- Chairman of national air carrier Middle East Airlines Khaled Salam says decision "positive".
- President of American University of Beirut, currently in United States, can now live in Lebanon.
- Pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militia bombards villages as army clears mines from Jezzine road.
- Truce committee meets to discuss ceasefire complaints, fired by Israel and Lebanon.
- Preparations for Beirut conference of Arab businessmen and investors.
- Rostropovich back in Baalbek for festival.
- Israeli shelling of Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridges, south Lebanon's eastern and western sectors.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu: I have dropped the proposition "Lebanon First" in negotiations with Syria.
